verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs describe Cursor CLI, an official terminal agent that installs with a one-line curl script. It runs interactively or headless in print mode, and its permissions can be configured in local or project config files. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration that the local terminal agent works as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Cursor CLI lets you interact with AI agents directly from your terminal to write, review, and modify code.
Cursor runs in your terminal, collaborates in Slack, and reviews PRs in GitHub.
Use print mode (`-p, --print`) for non-interactive scripting and automation
Configure what the agent is allowed to do using permission tokens
